core_obligations: Descent for morphisms: given local alpha_i : x|_{U_i} -> x'|_{U_i} agreeing on overlaps, descend F(alpha_i) to beta : F(x) -> F(x') using that T is a stack; view (x, beta) and (x', id) as sections of the assumption-(3) presheaf; their restrictions are isomorphic via alpha_i, so (3) gives alpha with F(alpha) = beta.
Use faithfulness of F on fibre categories to conclude alpha|_{U_i} = alpha_i.

Descent for objects: descend the datum (F(x_i)) to y in T_U with isomorphisms beta_i; view (x_i, beta_i) as sections of the assumption-(3) presheaf with isomorphisms varphi_{ij} between the restricted pairs.
Apply (3) to get (x, beta) whose restrictions are isomorphic to (x_i, beta_i); transport to morphisms alpha_i : x_i -> x|_{U_i} and verify varphi_{ij} = alpha_j o alpha_i^{-1} by faithfulness of F.
proof_roadmap: Both descent conditions are reduced to the sheaf property of the explicitly displayed local-section presheaf of assumption (3), with faithfulness of F cleaning up the restrictions.
difficulty_reason: Two separate descent arguments, each pairing an object with a morphism into the assumption-(3) presheaf, plus two faithfulness clean-up steps; the pairing construction is the substance.
